All eight validate with --resolve, 0 errors; zhang-lu has 4 warnings, all the one unknown place name Bazhong.

For ea-02-c: han-dynasty /ledger/98 (196 loss of Yong to han-sui) and /ledger/103 (211 gain from han-sui) still treat Yong as the Guanzhong. han-sui no longer holds the Guanzhong (Yong Province page: the 194 Yongzhou Inspectorate was the Hexi commanderies; the Three Guardians joined in 213); at 211 it loses only the Baoji circle, and Gansu with Ningxia is annexed 'over the next few years'. han-dynasty also still lacks mirrors for yellow-turbans, yuan-shao 199, shi-xie, qiang and the 23-25 regimes (review matrix).

For ea-03: shu-han is the counterpart of zhang-lu's 215 Bazhong gain; eastern-wu of shi-xie's 210 vassal_start and 227 vassal_end/loss and of sun-ce's dissolve; cao-cao of the Yuan, Liu Biao, Zhang Lu and Song Jian losses. None of those dossiers exists yet.

yellow-turbans carries the Heishan Taihang strip (185-205) as a confidence-1 placeholder although the Heishan bandits page says the founders were 'unrelated to the Yellow Turban movement'; the Zhang Yan page ties Zhang Yan to the revolt. yuan-shao cuts the same circle out of its Ji Province for 191-204 so the ground is held once.

Overlaps now removed (checked with the gazetteer, 0 shared cells): yuan-shao vs yellow-turbans; yuan-shao vs gongsun-zan except 199 (the year Yijing falls); han-sui vs song-jian and vs zhang-lu; zhang-lu vs liu-zhang; zhang-bu vs liu-yong. Disagreements with the reviewer are written up in the notes file: the Heishan are not Yellow Turbans on their own page; zhang-bu is one keyframe with three circles cut, not a split at 27 (a split would hand Jiyin-Shanyang back to Zhang Bu with no event); the reviewer's single-sentence End of the Han quotation for han-sui is two sentences on the page; han-sui needed a vassal_end 211/9 (not asked for) to pair the new vassal_start.
